# my-ai-app_chatbot_And_ReviewSummarizer

A full-stack AI app built with **React + Bun + Express + MySQL**. It has two pages:

- **Reviews** (`/reviews`) shows product reviews with skeleton loading, plus a one-click
  **AI summary** generated by a local LLM (Ollama + `tinyllama`). Summaries are cached in the DB for 7 days.
- **Chatbot** (`/chat`) is a customer-support assistant for the fictional _WonderWorld_ theme park,
  powered by OpenAI, with conversation memory.

## Tech stack

| Layer    | Tools                                                                  |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Frontend | React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, React Router |
| Backend  | Bun, Express 5, Zod, Prisma 7 (MariaDB adapter)                        |
| Database | MySQL 8                                                                |
| AI       | OpenAI Responses API (chatbot), Ollama `tinyllama` (review summaries)  |
| Tooling  | Bun workspaces, Prettier, Husky + lint-staged                          |

## Prerequisites

- [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.3+
- MySQL 8: either [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) (easiest) or a local MySQL install
- [Ollama](https://ollama.com) with the model pulled: `ollama pull tinyllama` (for review summaries)
- An [OpenAI API key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) (for the chatbot)

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pravin-v-ingle/my-ai-app_chatbot_And_ReviewSummarizer.git
cd my-ai-app_chatbot_And_ReviewSummarizer

# 1. Configure environment (then put your OpenAI key in the new .env)
cp packages/server/.env.example packages/server/.env

# 2. Start MySQL (skip if you use your own MySQL; then update .env to match)
docker compose up -d

# 3. Install deps, run migrations, and load sample reviews
bun run setup

# 4. Run client + server together
bun run dev
```

Open http://localhost:5173. The client runs on port 5173 and the API on http://localhost:3000.

### Sample data

`bun run setup` runs the seed script (`packages/server/prisma/seed.ts`), which loads 4 products
and their reviews. Product 4 is the one shown on the Reviews page. The seed can be re-run at any time
to reset the sample reviews:

```bash
bun run db:seed
```

> **Note:** re-seeding replaces existing reviews and summaries for products 1–4.

## API

| Method | Endpoint                              | Description                       |
| ------ | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/products/:id/reviews`           | Reviews and cached summary        |
| POST   | `/api/products/:id/reviews/summarize` | Generate an AI summary of reviews |
| POST   | `/api/chat`                           | Send a message to the chatbot     |

## Project structure

```
my-ai-app_chatbot_And_ReviewSummarizer/
├── index.ts                  # starts client + server together (concurrently)
├── docker-compose.yml        # local MySQL
└── packages/
    ├── client/               # React + Vite frontend
    │   └── src/
    │       ├── pages/        # ReviewsPage, ChatPage
    │       └── components/   # chat/, reviews/, ui/
    └── server/               # Bun + Express API
        ├── controller/       # request handling + validation
        ├── services/         # business logic
        ├── repositories/     # Prisma data access
        ├── llm/              # OpenAI / Ollama client + prompts
        └── prisma/           # schema, migrations, seed.ts
```

## Environment & secrets

All configuration lives in `packages/server/.env`, which is **git-ignored and never committed**.
`packages/server/.env.example` lists every variable with placeholder values. Each user supplies
their own API key, and no keys ship with this repo.
